The '''HXI-54 Juggernaut''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] stationed aboard the [[Republic Navy]]'s [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] ''[[Dorin's Sky]]''. During the [[Galactic War]], the ''Dorin's Sky'' was boarded by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], and the HXI-54 Juggernaut was destroyed in the battle.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The HXI-54 Juggernaut appears as one of the bosses in the Boarding Party Flashpoint appearing in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
